sanskrit: puru tvā dāśivāṃ voce 'riragne tava svidā . todasyeva śaraṇa ā mahasya
english: I, ever-giving, call upon you much, O Agni — truly yours. Like a refuge from the sharp thorn, you are a shelter of greatness.

sanskrit: pra hotre pūrvyaṃ vaco 'gnaye bharatā bṛhat . vipāṃ jyotīṃṣi bibhrate na vedhase
english: Carry forth the ancient word, great and primal, to Agni the Hotṛ. Like a sage bearing the lights of the waters, he is the wise ordainer.

sanskrit: agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho . asme dhehi jātavedo mahi śravaḥ
english: O Agni, lord of wealth rich in cattle, O son of strength — grant to us, O Jātavedas, great renown.

sanskrit: agne yajiṣṭho adhvare devāṃ devayate yaja . hotā mandro vi rājasyati sridhaḥ
english: O Agni, most worthy of worship at the rite, sacrifice to the gods for the god-seeking worshipper. The Hotṛ, gladdening, shines forth, dispelling failures.

sanskrit: jajñānaḥ sapta mātṛbhirmedhāmāśāsata śriye . ayaṃ dhruvo rayīṇāṃ ciketadā
english: Born, he sought wisdom from the seven mothers for glory. This one, firm and steadfast among riches, became discerning.

sanskrit: uta syā no divā matiraditirūtyāgamat . sā śantātā mayaskaradapa sridhaḥ
english: And may this thought of ours, Aditi, come to us by day with her aid. May she, bringing peace, grant us delight and drive away failures.

sanskrit: īḍiṣvā hi pratīvyā3ṃ yajasva jātavedasam . cariṣṇudhūmamagṛbhītaśociṣam
english: Praise him indeed, worship Jātavedas who faces all directions — whose smoke moves freely, whose flame cannot be grasped.

sanskrit: na tasya māyayā ca na ripurīśīta martyaḥ . yo agnaye dadāśa havyadātaye
english: No mortal foe can overcome him, whether by craft or cunning, who has given offering to Agni, the receiver of oblations.

sanskrit: apa tyaṃ vṛjinaṃ ripuṃ stenamagne durādhyam . daviṣṭhamasya satpate kṛdhī sugam
english: Drive away that crooked foe, that thief, O Agni, that ill-minded one. Make the path easy, far away from him, O lord of the good.

sanskrit: śruṣṭyagne navasya me stomasya vīra viśpate . ni māyinastapasā rakṣaso daha
english: Hear, O Agni, my new hymn of praise, O hero, lord of peoples. Burn down with your heat the deceitful demons.

sanskrit: upastutāso agnaye
english: Praises go up to Agni.

sanskrit: pra so agne tavotibhiḥ suvīrābhistarati vājakarmabhiḥ . yasya tvaṃ sakhyamāvitha
english: He, O Agni, crosses over with your aids, with good heroes, with prize-winning deeds — he whose friendship you have cherished.

sanskrit: taṃ gūrdhayā svarṇaraṃ devāso devamaratiṃ dadhanvire . devatrā havyamūhiṣe
english: Honour him, the swift golden one; the gods have sent the divine messenger onward. You carry the oblation to the gods.

sanskrit: mā no hṛṇīthā atithiṃ vasuragniḥ purupraśasta eśaḥ . yaḥ suhotā svadhvaraḥ
english: Let not Agni, the wealth-giving guest, much-praised and ruling, be wrathful with us — he who is the good Hotṛ, the one of excellent rites.

sanskrit: bhadro no agnirāhuto bhadrā rātiḥ subhaga bhadro adhvaraḥ . bhadrā uta praśastayaḥ
english: Auspicious is Agni when invoked for us, auspicious is his gift, O blessed one; auspicious is the rite, and auspicious too are the praises.

sanskrit: yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā vavṛmahe devaṃ devatrā hotāramamartyam . asya yajñasya sukratum
english: We have chosen you, most worthy of worship, divine Hotṛ among the gods, immortal — of good purpose for this sacrifice.

sanskrit: tadagne dyumnamā bhara yatsāsāhā sadane kaṃ cidatriṇam . manyuṃ janasya dūḍhyam
english: O Agni, bring that splendour which, conquering all, sits in the abode, overcoming every devourer — the wrath of the ill-minded among people.

sanskrit: yadvā u viśpatiḥ śitaḥ suprīto manuṣo viśe . viśvedagniḥ prati rakṣāṃsi sedhati
english: Or when the lord of the clan, sharp and well-pleased, guards the tribe of Manu — then Agni of all things repels the demons.

sanskrit: tadvo gāya sute sacā puruhūtāya satvane . śaṃ yadgave na śākine
english: Sing that for him, when the Soma is pressed, together, to the much-invoked hero — as a blessing, like to the able bull for the cow.

sanskrit: yaste nūnaṃ śatakratavindra dyumnitamo madaḥ . tena nūnaṃ made madeḥ
english: That rapture of yours, O Indra of a hundred powers, which is most radiant — with that rapture exhilarate us now.

sanskrit: gāva upa vadāvaṭe mahi yajñasya rapsudā . ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā
english: The cows low near the great trough, the prize-giver of the sacrifice, with both its golden ears.

sanskrit: aramaśvāya gāyata śrutakakṣāraṃ gave . aramindrasya dhāmne
english: Sing fittingly for the horse, for the famous one of the shoulder-strap, and for the cow — fittingly for the dwelling of Indra.

sanskrit: tamindraṃ vājayāmasi mahe vṛtrāya hantave . sa vṛṣā vṛṣabho bhuvat
english: We speed on Indra, great for the slaying of Vṛtra. May he be the bull, the virile one.

sanskrit: tvamindra balādadhi sahaso jāta ojasaḥ . tvaṃ sanvṛṣanvṛṣedasi
english: You, O Indra, were born above strength, from might and vigour. You, winning as a bull, are the bull indeed.

sanskrit: yajña indramavardhayadyadbhūmiṃ vyavartayat . cakrāṇa opaśaṃ divi
english: The sacrifice strengthened Indra when he rolled back the earth and made an attachment in the sky.

sanskrit: yadindrāhaṃ tathā tvamīśīya vasva eka it . stotā me gosakhā syāt
english: O Indra, if I were as you, the sole lord of wealth — then my singer would be the companion of my cattle.

sanskrit: panyaṃpanyamitsotāra ā dhāvata madyāya . somaṃ vīrāya śūrāya
english: O pressers, hasten again and again, worthy of praise, for the exhilarating drink — Soma for the hero, for the champion.

sanskrit: idaṃ vaso sutamandhaḥ pibā supūrṇamudaram . anābhayinrarimā te
english: O Vasu, drink this pressed Soma-juice with a well-filled belly. We have granted it to you without fear.

sanskrit: astārameṣi sūrya
english: You travel, O Sun, as the unsetting one.

sanskrit: yadadya kacca vṛtrahannudagā abhi sūrya . sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe
english: Whatever you rise over today, O Vṛtra-slayer, O Sun shining upon all — all that, O Indra, is under your will.

sanskrit: ya ānayatparāvataḥ sunītī turvaśaṃ yadum . indraḥ sa no yuvā sakhā
english: He who led Turvaśa and Yadu from the distant land with good guidance — that Indra is our ever-young companion.

sanskrit: mā na indrābhyā ' '3 diśaḥ sūro aktuṣvā yamata . tvā yujā vanema tat
english: O Indra, let not the sun restrain us from any direction in the night. With you as ally may we win that.

sanskrit: endra sānasiṃ rayiṃ sajitvānaṃ sadāsaham . varṣiṣṭhamūtaye bhara
english: O Indra, bring the winning wealth, conquering and ever-victorious, the most abundant, for our aid.

sanskrit: indraṃ vayaṃ mahādhana indramarbhe havāmahe . yujaṃ vṛtreṣu vajriṇam
english: We call upon Indra in the great battle for great wealth, and Indra in the small — the thunderbolt-wielder, the yoke-fellow in conflicts.

sanskrit: apibatkadruvaḥ sutamindraḥ sahasrabāhve . tatrādadiṣṭa pauṃsyam
english: Indra drank the pressed Soma of the Kadrū plant at the thousand-armed one's feast. There he declared his heroic might.

sanskrit: vayamindra tvāyavo 'bhi pra nonumo vṛṣan . viddhī tvā3sya no vaso
english: We who desire you, O Indra, call out to you again and again, O bull. Know yourself as ours, O lord of wealth.

sanskrit: ā ghā ye agnimindhate stṛṇanti barhirānuṣak . yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā
english: Those who kindle Agni and strew the sacred grass in order — Indra is the ever-young companion of such men.

sanskrit: bhindhi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ pari bādho jahī mṛdhaḥ . vasu spārhaṃ tadā bhara
english: Break all enmities, repel the pressures on every side, slay the scorners. Then bring the desirable wealth.

sanskrit: ni yāmaṃ citramṛñjate
english: They adorn the wondrous path downward.

sanskrit: ima u tvā vi cakṣate sakhāya indra sominaḥ . puṣṭāvanto yathā paśum
english: These Soma-pressing companions gaze upon you, O Indra — as those rich in cattle watch over the animal.

sanskrit: samasya manyave viśo viśvā namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ . samudrāyeva sindhavaḥ
english: Before the wrath of that one, all peoples and all tribes bow down — as rivers bow to the ocean.

sanskrit: devānāmidavo mahattadā vṛṇīmahe vayam . vṛṣṇāmasmabhyamūtaye
english: The great help of the gods — that we choose for ourselves; the aid of the bountiful bulls, for our protection.

sanskrit: somānāṃ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate . kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ
english: Make the Soma-cups resound, O Lord of Prayer. May the Auśija, he of the armpit, Kakṣīvant, be your Soma-drinker.

sanskrit: bodhanmanā idastu no vṛtrahā bhūryāsutiḥ . śṛṇotu śakra āśiṣam
english: Let the Vṛtra-slayer of many pressings be alert in mind for us. May the mighty Śakra hear the blessing.

sanskrit: adya no deva savitaḥ prajāvatsāvīḥ saubhagam . parā duḥṣvapnyaṃ suva
english: O divine Savitṛ, today impel auspicious fortune for us together with progeny. Drive away ill dreams.

sanskrit: kvā3sya vṛṣabho yuvā tuvigrīvo anānataḥ . brahmā kastaṃ saparyati
english: Where is this young bull, thick-necked and unbowing? What Brahmin priest serves him with devotion?

sanskrit: upahvare girīṇāṃ saṅgame ca nadīnām . dhiyā vipro ajāyata
english: In the hidden place of the mountains and at the confluence of the rivers, the wise one was born through inspired thought.

sanskrit: pra samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāmindraṃ stotā navyaṃ gīrbhiḥ . naraṃ nṛṣāhaṃ maṃhiṣṭham
english: Let the praiser sing forth, with fresh songs, Indra the sovereign of all peoples, the hero, the vanquisher of men, the most bountiful.

sanskrit: apādu śiprayandhasaḥ sudakṣasya prahoṣiṇaḥ . indrorindro yavāśiraḥ
english: He drank with his jaw the Soma juice of him of beautiful jaw, the well-skilled one who pours offerings — Indra indeed is Indra, the barley-mixed.
